title: Retro-AtariST
shortDescription: Native Atari ST, STE, TT and Falcon emulation with EmuTOS and touch controls
fullDescription:
Bring the Atari ST family to your Android device with a native, touch-first front end built on the Hatari emulator. Retro-AtariST supports the Atari ST, Mega ST, STE, Mega STE, TT and Falcon 030.

RUN IT STRAIGHT AWAY
The app includes the free, open-source EmuTOS replacement ROM and an original core-test demo. It can boot and demonstrate CPU, video and input without an Atari ROM, commercial game, account or network connection.

USE SOFTWARE YOU OWN
Add your own legally obtained ST, MSA, DIM, STX, IPF, IMG and ZIP disk images. You can also supply an original Atari TOS image that you are entitled to use; EmuTOS remains the legal built-in default.

MADE FOR MOBILE
Use the full-width on-screen Atari keyboard, touch joystick, mouse input or a physical controller. Choose 4:3 or 16:9 display presentation and swap disks for multi-disk software while emulation is running.

LIBRARY AND ARTWORK
Organise compatible media in the visual library. Optional Crown Park Computing RetroMedia sign-in can match local titles and download artwork to the device. Passwords are not stored by the app.

FEATURES
- Native Hatari-based Atari ST-family emulation
- ST, Mega ST, STE, Mega STE, TT and Falcon 030 models
- Bundled EmuTOS and an original offline demo
- ST, MSA, DIM, STX, IPF, IMG and ZIP media support
- On-screen Atari keyboard, touch joystick and physical controller input
- 4:3 and 16:9 presentation options
- Multi-disk swapping
- Optional RetroMedia library artwork
- Interpreter-only 68000/68030 CPU core with no JIT

Retro-AtariST includes no Atari TOS ROM and no commercial games. Add only software and ROM images you are legally entitled to use.

Retro-AtariST links Hatari and is released under the GNU General Public License version 2 or later.
